item.title: [ Mod ] Left 4 Meow
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 6
• Version 1.1: 10 cats to choose from! New: black, white, calico, Bengal, gray & white and Russian Blue. • Cat menus work in chat: type !catemotes, !catlook or !catacc and then just the number. • No conflict with Admin Menu. • Follows you anywhere: finds its way, jumps over obstacles, climbs ladders and copies your jumps and shortcuts. • Swims, and rides elevators, platforms and the rescue vehicle with you. • Meows, purrs when you pet it, and hisses at the Witch. • If you go down it runs to your side and meows until someone picks you up, if you die it stays next to your body and gets up with you when you're revived. • When it meets another player's cat, they sniff each other and play for a while. • Sits, naps when you stand still, kneads, chases its tail and rolls belly up. • Carries your medkit or defibrillator on its back, and pills or adrenaline in its pockets. • Four looks: tuxedo, orange, brown tabby or Siamese. • Halloween accessories: a witch hat and flapping bat wings. • Help and menus in your game language (8 languages). Command What it does !cat Gives you your cat or makes it follow you again !stay Stays where it is (crouching next to it works too) !cathere Goes where your crosshair points and waits there !catmeet Your cat and the nearest player's cat meet right away to sniff and play !catpic Photo mode: appears where you aim, facing you, and stays still (emotes still work; !cat ends it) !catbye Removes your cat, also on the next maps (!cat brings it back) !sleep / !sniff / !stretch / !knead Sleeps / sniffs / stretches / kneads while purring !tail / !roll / !yawn Chases its tail / rolls belly up / yawns !catemotes Emote menu: 1 Stay / Follow · 2 Meow · 3 Knead · 4 Stretch · 5 Sniff · 6 Chase tail · 7 Roll over · 8 Yawn · 9 Sleep !catlook Look menu: 1 Tuxedo · 2 Orange · 3 Brown tabby · 4 Siamese · 5 Black · 6 White · 7 Russian Blue. Your pick is remembered, even after restarting the game !catacc Accessories: 1 Witch hat · 2 Bat wings (each one toggles on/off) · 3 Remove all. The wings hide while it carries a medkit or defibrillator Using the menus Type the command and the options show up in chat, then type just the number within 30 seconds. Or type both at once, like !catlook 2. Works for every player. !cathelp Help in chat • M2 (shove) up close: pets it. • Left click on it holding a medkit or defibrillator: puts it on its back. Pills or adrenaline go in its pocket. • E on what it carries: takes it back. • Crouch next to it: it stays still so you can look at it up close.

Description Lima Infection: Survivors is a custom character pack developed by Amauta Collective, featuring four Peruvian survivors inspired by local personalities and characters chosen by the community. These survivors are part of the expanded Lima Infection universe, each with their own identity and story within the zombie outbreak in Peru. Compatibility This addon may conflict with other mods that replace the same survivors. Disable conflicting addons before playing. item.title: [ 8 Maps ] Blood Medal (alpha release)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
This version is NOT complete and is currently undergoing intensive development. It is a technical test focused exclusively on chapters 3 and 6. Please report any bugs or performance issues in the comments to help improve the final version. After being rescued in New Orleans (The Parish), the Left 4 Dead 2 survivors are drafted and trained by the US Army as a special operations unit. Their new mission takes them to a hostile desert, where a Russian-North Korean military alliance has weaponized the Green Flu virus. Inside a secret installation, the enemy has successfully engineered and contained a giant biological abomination. Backed by the US military, the survivors must infiltrate the desert base, fight through waves of Russian and North Korean soldiers determined to stop them, and plant C4 charges to blow up the entire complex. • Chapters 1 to 7: Tactical military combat. The main enemies are Russian and North Korean soldiers; there are no infected present. • Chapter 8 (Finale): The infiltration peaks. As the explosives are set, the base collapses, unleashing the giant abomination and hordes of zombies for a chaotic final escape.
